# AlienVault credentials

## Prerequisites

Create an [AlienVault](https://otx.alienvault.com) account.

## Supported authentication methods

- API key

## Related resources

Refer to [AlienVault's documentation](https://otx.alienvault.com/api) for more information about the service.

This is a credential-only node. Refer to [Custom API operations](../custom-api-actions-for-existing-nodes.md) to learn more. View [example workflows and related content](https://n8n.io/integrations/alienvault/) on n8n's website.

## Using API key

To configure this credential, you'll need:

- An **OTX Key**: Once you have an AlienVault account, the **OTX Key** displays in your **Settings**.
